steps.comment: accept API-GW request and push onto queue

processors.script: var response = context.sendToStep(`aws-services`, `sqs-request`, JSON.stringify( { aws_sqs_queue : context.getData(`emailSqsQueue`), action : 'SendMessage', params : { MessageBody : JSON.parse(context.getBody()).body } }  )); context.setProperty(`status_code`, response.getProperty(`status_code`));

context.setProperty(`useResponse`, `true`); const r = { statusCode : parseInt(context.getProperty(`status_code`))}; const b = { status : r.statusCode, message : context.getData(`responseMessage`) }; if (b.status != 200) b.message = `Sorry. An error occurred. Please try again`; r.body = JSON.stringify(b); context.setBody(JSON.stringify(r))

steps.comment: accept message from SQS and send email

processors.script:
const input = JSON.parse(JSON.parse(context.getBody()).Records[0].body); context.setBody(`This email was sent from the website.

 from: ${input.fromName}<${input.fromEmail}>
Company: ${input.company}

Message:
${input.message}`)

context.setProperty(`status_code`, context.sendToStep(`aws-services`, `ses-request`, JSON.stringify( { path : `/v2/email/outbound-emails`, method : `POST`, body : { FromEmailAddress: context.getData(`fromAddress`), Destination : { ToAddresses : JSON.parse(context.getData(`toAddress`))}, Content: { Simple : { Subject: { Data: context.getData(`subject`) }, Body : { Text : { Data : context.getBody() }}}}}})).getProperty(`status_code`))
